hadiths.text: Rapporté par Abu Huraira رضي الله عنه : Le Messager d’Allah ﷺ a dit : « Quand une femme passe la nuit loin du lit de son mari, les anges la maudissent jusqu’au matin. »

chapter.ara-name: باب تَحْرِيمِ امْتِنَاعِهَا مِنْ فِرَاشِ زَوْجِهَا
chapter.eng-name: It is unlawful for the wife to refuse to come to her husband's bed
